title: CFB Top Picks Repair Mission — Step 1 Matchup History Router
project: CFB Top Picks Missing Research Repair
problem: Production Top Picks displayed SOURCE_CONFLICT_REVIEW for Virginia vs Florida St. even though the teams have verified historical meetings.
root_cause: The Top Picks router sent the display abbreviation Florida St. into the shared Winsipedia slug guesser, producing florida-st instead of Winsipedia's canonical florida-state slug. ESPN's limited recent-history lane did not independently recover the all-time series, so the router correctly failed closed into SOURCE_CONFLICT_REVIEW.
patch: Normalize trailing CFB display abbreviation St./St to State inside the Top Picks Winsipedia lookup lane only, record the canonical lookup alias, and preserve ESPN identity plus all model/ranking/selection weights at zero.
